en.headline: Two women arrested after fight near Tsim Sha Tsui Clock Tower
en.dek: Police received a report at about 6.57pm of a confrontation on Salisbury Road; both women were arrested for fighting in a public place and taken to hospital with injuries.
body: Police arrested two women on Tuesday evening after a fight near the Clock Tower on the Tsim Sha Tsui waterfront.

Officers received a report at about 6.57pm of a woman being punched by another woman on Salisbury Road. Initial inquiries indicated the pair had an earlier argument. One woman, aged 51, reported head and hand injuries; the other, aged 59, reported injuries to her back, hands and fingers.
Both were arrested on suspicion of fighting in a public place and taken to Kwong Wah Hospital for treatment. The case is being followed by the Yau Tsim District Crime Squad.
Video of the incident circulated online showing one woman pinning the other to the ground before bystanders intervened.

zh.headline: 尖沙咀鐘樓附近兩女打架被捕 送院治理
zh.dek: 警方晚上約6時57分接報梳士巴利道有女子被拳打；兩名女子涉嫌在公眾地方打鬥被捕，分別報稱頭部及背部受傷並送往廣華醫院。
body: 警方周二晚上在尖沙咀海濱鐘樓附近拘捕兩名女子，她們涉嫌在公眾地方打鬥。
警方於晚上約6時57分接報，指梳士巴利道有一名女子被另一名女子拳打。初步調查顯示，兩人較早時曾有爭執。一名51歲女子報稱頭部及手部受傷；另一名59歲女子則報稱背部、手部及手指受傷。
兩人均涉嫌在公眾地方打鬥被拘捕，並送往廣華醫院治理。案件交由油尖警區刑事調查隊跟進。
網上片段顯示其中一名女子將另一人壓在地上，其後有途人上前勸阻。
